kind.description: stated kind; omitted = classified from the text

resolves.description: card id whose open items this entry settles

sha.description: the commit this entry was true of (SW-044). Evidence without one cannot be expired — it can only be dated.

dirty.description: the tree carried uncommitted changes, so this entry is not reproducible from its sha

noteEntry.description: One dated thing somebody learned, decided, or was bitten by. Append-only by protocol: push an entry, never edit one.

notesSidecarLine.description: ONE LINE OF .shipward/notes.jsonl, which this schema DOCUMENTS rather than validates — that file is JSONL and JSON Schema describes a single document at a time. A line is a noteEntry plus the card it belongs to. Oldest first, append-only, never rewritten and never compacted: it is the memory, and the protocol above it says push an entry rather than edit one. A line that will not parse is skipped and COUNTED on stderr rather than dropped in silence; an absent file is a board that has never written a note, not an error. The store spreads the entry whole rather than copying named fields (SW-053 added sha and dirty and an earlier field-by-field copy dropped them silently), so treat these properties as what is KNOWN to travel, not as a closed set.

card.description: the card this entry is filed under — a finding goes under the card that FOUND it, not the code it concerns

description: The BOARD. Note text lives beside it in .shipward/notes.jsonl — see $defs.notesSidecarLine. The two files hold DISJOINT facts: after a write the tracker carries no note text and the sidecar carries no board state, so there is nothing for them to disagree about. Commit them together — a board without its memory is cards with nothing written on them.
title: Shipward tracker file (.shipward/tracker.json)

rev.description: Server-owned monotonic write counter (SW-059). The store stamps it on every locked write and journals it to the untracked .shipward/last-write.json; a tracker whose rev is below that journal's was rewritten by something that never took the lock — almost always a git checkout/reset. Hand edits carry it forward unchanged. Absent on boards written before it existed (read as 0).

activeProject.description: Project id the UI shows by default

checks.description: Named checks done() may run, declared by a HUMAN (SW-043). No MCP tool writes this map. Each value is an argv array run without a shell, so a check cannot carry a payload.

checkTimeoutMs.description: how long a check may run before it counts as absence of evidence; default 120000

p.description: project id this card belongs to

claude.description: Claude Code's own state while status='claude'

commit.description: short sha of the latest relevant commit

note.description: Since SW-039 note entries are STORED in .shipward/notes.jsonl, not here — a written tracker carries no note text at all, and $defs.notesSidecarLine is the shape of a line there. This field remains valid because the store hydrates it on every read (so every consumer still sees card.note) and because hand-editing a note straight into the tracker is still supported: the next write moves it to the sidecar.

check.description: NAME of a check declared in this card's project. A name nothing declares is unverified, never executed (SW-043).

verification.description: What the last check proved, and about which tree (SW-043). Absence means nothing was ever run.

exit.description: null when the check timed out or could not be spawned

sha.description: HEAD when the check ran — what SW-044 reads to expire this evidence

dirty.description: true if the tree carried uncommitted changes; a pass nobody else can reproduce

msg.description: one human-readable line, e.g. 'Claude Code pushed 3f8c21a — BW-014 moved to Review'
